base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl python3-venv python3-dev libgdal-dev gdal-bin libnetcdf-dev libhdf5-dev libproj-dev libgeos-dev build-essential pkg-config
runtime_smoke_command: python -c 'from ravenpy.config.commands import CustomOutput; c = CustomOutput(time_per="YEARLY", stat="AVERAGE", variable="PRECIP", space_agg="ENTIRE_WATERSHED"); print(c.to_rv())'

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: Use the activated venv; pytest is included in dev dependencies
runtime_profile.notes: RavenPy requires GDAL and raven-hydro as special dependencies. The environment uses a system-wide venv at /opt/benchmark/venv. Project is installed in editable mode with dev dependencies including pytest.

notes: RavenPy is a Python package for hydrological modeling. The base image python:3.11-slim provides a clean Python 3.11 environment. git and curl are explicitly included as baseline system packages. GDAL requires libgdal-dev, gdal-bin, and python3-dev for the Python GDAL bindings. raven-hydro is the Raven hydrological framework dependency. The project uses flit as the build backend. Dev dependencies include pytest, pytest-xdist for parallel testing, and other development tools. Optional GIS dependencies (geopandas, rasterio, etc.) are not included by default but can be installed via pip install ravenpy[gis] if needed.
